message: packageManager in package.json (line 4) pins npm@12.2.1, but Node.js >=25 in engines (package.json) does not come with Corepack (Node.js 25.0.0 stopped distributing it), and Corepack is what reads that pin: without a separate Corepack install, npm there is whatever npm comes with that Node.js
fix: Install Corepack wherever Node.js >=25 is used for this project (npm install -g corepack, then corepack enable npm), as the Corepack README says for a Node.js without it; npm itself does not read packageManager, while it checks devEngines.packageManager itself
